hook: One miner once left a whole Bitcoin reward on the table.

scenes.narration: The miner of block five hundred one thousand, seven hundred twenty-six claimed none of its twelve and a half bitcoin subsidy.
A miner may claim less than the subsidy plus fees.
Any amount not claimed is destroyed.

cta: Mistake or message? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: The Miner Who Skipped a 12.5 BTC Reward
description_body: A 2017 block left its subsidy unclaimed, and unclaimed rewards are destroyed.
